settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: For now your progress is stored only in this browser. Export it to a JSON file as a backup, or import it on another computer.
settings.exportDescription: Downloads a file with your solved exercises, attempts and notes.
settings.importDescription: Choose a file that was exported from Kata Stack.
settings.importReplaceHint: Deletes the current progress and uses the one from the file.
settings.importMergeHint: Keeps both; for the same exercise the newer record wins.
